title: A phase II clinical trial of inotuzumab ozogamicin as prophylaxis for relapse in patients with lymphoblastic leukaemia after allogeneic stem cell haemotopoietic transplantation
official: Multicenter, open label, phase II clinical trial of inotuzumab ozogamicin as prophylaxis for relapse in patients with high-risk acute B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukaemia after allogeneic stem cell haemotopoietic transplantation
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of InO in the prevention of relapse after allo-HSCT in adult patients with high-risk BCP-ALL treated according to the PETHEMA ALL- 2025 protocol in terms of the relapse rate, the CIR, and the DFS.

interventions.name: BESPONSA 1 mg powder for concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient is, in the investigator’s opinion, willing and able to adhere/comply with visit schedule and other protocol requirements
2. Patient must be able to understand the study procedures
3. Patients aged ≥18 years at the time of signing the informed consent form
4. Patient must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score of ≤ 2
5. Patient with CD22-positive high risk ALL according to any of the following criteria: i. Definition of high risk ALL according to the PETHEMA LAL 2019 protocol criteria including MRD stratification at the end of induction and during treatment and adverse cytogenetics at diagnosis (hypodiploid karyotype, KMT2A (MLL) alterations, homozygous TP53 deletions/mutations, and IKZF1 and CDKN2A/B deletions). ii. Patients who are in first CR at the time of transplantation, irrespective of MRD status as assessed by immunophenotypic study. iii. Allo-HSCT from an HLA-identical, mismatched or haploidentical sibling or unrelated donor, with myeloablative, reduced toxicity or non-myeloablative conditioning. iv. Stable hematopoietic engraftment defined by neutrophils >1000/μL for at least 3 consecutive days and platelets >50000/μL for 7 days with transfusion independence and donor chimerism >90% assessed in peripheral blood.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Prior exposure to inotuzumab ozogamicin
2. Bilirubin, GOT and GPT > 2 times the upper limit of the institution's reference values
3. History of previous liver disease or hepatic veno-occlusive disease/sinusoid obstruction syndrome
4. Active hepatitis B or C
5. Fungal infection or relevant uncontrolled infection
6. Active grade 3-4 acute graft-versus-host disease or acute or chronic hepatic graft-versus- host disease grade >2
7. Graft-versus-host disease prophylaxis with sirolimus at enrolment that cannot be discontinued prior to initiation of trial treatment
8. Ph-positive lymphoblastic leukemia
9. Absence of haematological recovery
10. Uncontrolled concomitant disease (cardiac, renal, pulmonary, psychiatric)
11. Uncontrolled non-hematological tumor
12. Any serious medical condition or psychiatric illness that would interfere in understanding of the informed consent form
13. Any serious medical condition that places the subject at an unacceptable risk if he or she participates in this study
14. Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding, or who intends to become pregnant during participation in the study, and men and women of reproductive potential who are not using effective contraceptive methods (double barrier method, intrauterine device, oral contraception)
15. Cord blood HSCT
16. Creatinine clearance <30 ml/minute
